jr.ny.title: New York City
jr.ny.subtitle: Central Park to Brooklyn Bridge
jr.ny.summary: From the zoo in Central Park, through Times Square, all the way to the Brooklyn Bridge. About 2–3 weeks.

pc.ny.zoo.name: Central Park Zoo
pc.ny.zoo.back: Tucked inside Central Park, the zoo is a favorite stop for families and first walks alike.
pc.ny.zoo.coachLine: Your very first stop. Here's to many more.

pc.ny.bethesda.name: Bethesda Fountain
pc.ny.bethesda.back: The fountain sits by the lake in the middle of the park, with a wide terrace for resting and people-watching.
pc.ny.bethesda.coachLine: A lovely place to catch your breath.

pc.ny.times.name: Times Square
pc.ny.times.back: Bright screens, busy sidewalks and theaters all around. It's one of the most famous crossroads in the world.
pc.ny.times.coachLine: Look how far those minutes have carried you.

pc.ny.bryant.name: Bryant Park
pc.ny.bryant.back: A leafy park in Midtown, with a lawn, green chairs and a quiet library next door.
pc.ny.bryant.coachLine: A calm spot in the middle of it all.

pc.ny.union.name: Union Square
pc.ny.union.back: A lively square with a farmers market on many days of the week.
pc.ny.union.coachLine: Almost at the river. Keep going.

pc.ny.bridge.name: Brooklyn Bridge
pc.ny.bridge.back: The bridge crosses the East River to Brooklyn, with a wide walkway above the traffic.
pc.ny.bridge.coachLine: You walked all of New York. I'm so proud of you.

jr.smoky.title: Smoky Mountains and the Blue Ridge Parkway
jr.smoky.summary: Quiet valleys, waterfalls and mountain views, from Cades Cove to the Linn Cove Viaduct. About 4–6 weeks.

jr.camino.title: The Camino de Santiago
jr.camino.subtitle: the last 100 km
jr.camino.summary: Stone villages and green hills of Galicia, from Sarria to the great square in Santiago. About 4–6 weeks.

jr.ne.title: New England lighthouses
jr.ne.subtitle: Maine to Cape Cod
jr.ne.summary: Rocky coastline and white lighthouses, from Portland Head Light to Nauset Light. About 4–6 weeks.

jr.pch.title: Pacific Coast Highway
jr.pch.subtitle: Big Sur
jr.pch.summary: Cliffs, beaches and ocean views, from Carmel-by-the-Sea past Bixby Bridge. About 4–6 weeks.
